description: [Experimental web session] Create a workspace (dashboard) in AppMetrica itself in one call. groups is an ordered list of rows; a group is {header?: string, widgets?: WidgetInput[]} (header and widgets in one group become a header row followed by a widgets row). A widget is exactly one of: preset (web preset id), funnel_id (saved funnel), or metrics (custom widget: namespace derived from the metric prefix, metric/dimension ids validated against the namespace). Limits: 20 dashboards per app, 20 widgets and 40 groups per dashboard. Returns {dashboard_id, name, url, groups}. Uses the unofficial AppMetrica web API through a headless Chrome session: run `npx appmetrica-mcp login` once to log in to Yandex. Requires APPMETRICA_ALLOW_WRITE=true.

widgets.description: Widgets shown side by side in one row

dimensions.description: Custom widget: dimension ids (full keys or bare suffixes of the namespace)

funnel_id.description: Saved funnel ID (list_funnels): creates a Funnels widget bound to that funnel

metrics.description: Custom widget: metric ids of one namespace, e.g. ym:u:users

name.description: Custom widget title (default: the first metric's title)

namespace.description: Custom widget: report namespace id (web_list_report_namespaces); derived from the first metric's ym:*: prefix when omitted

preset.description: Web preset widget id, e.g. AudienceMulti, Installs, CrashFreeSessions (web_list_widget_presets)

view_kind.description: Timeline (default), TimeColumn, Table, Pie, MultiTimeColumn, FunnelFirstStep (funnels default); other values are passed through

name: web_create_workspace
